question: What kinds of persons are disqualified by lacking devotion to kula and guru?
premises: Devotion to kula may be absent
Devotion to guru may be absent
inference: The verse identifies those devoid of devotion to kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of these locatives depends on the following verse
plain_english: In one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
